mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions and strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: In periods of rising PAYEMS, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.8%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investor sentiment weakens.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.8%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an economic contraction amid monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth fears dominate.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO falls and FEDFUNDS rises, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 205), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stagflationary risks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as central banks face a policy dilemma.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 205 AND UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 205 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand for housing and broader economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: In periods of rising HOUST, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month indicates monetary easing, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of declining FEDFUNDS, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
